## Motivation

During incremental tool-call streaming (`FunctionCallParser.parse_stream_chunk`), `BaseFormatDetector.parse_streaming_increment` currently re-runs four $O(N)$ operations across the entire accumulated buffer on **every token chunk** while streaming a tool call's arguments:

1. `_partial_json_loads(current_text[start_idx:], flags)` (`partial_json_parser` scans the entire open JSON string character-by-character in Python to complete it, followed by `json.loads`).
2. `_is_complete_json(raw_slice)` (`orjson.loads` over the growing slice).
3. Two full `json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False)` serializations (`cur_arguments` and `prev_arguments`).
4. `_find_common_prefix(prev_args_json, cur_args_json)` in `sglang/srt/function_call/utils.py`, which loops character-by-character in Python (`prefix += s1[i]`) from index `0` on every chunk.

For tool calls with medium-to-large string arguments (such as coding-agent `write_file`, `edit_file`, patch, or SQL/document payloads of 12–20 KB streamed in ~3-character token chunks), this quadratic $O(N^2)$ work blocks the serving loop for **7–20+ seconds of CPU time per tool call** across all detectors backed by `BaseFormatDetector` (`Qwen25Detector`, `HermesDetector`, `Llama32Detector`, `MistralDetector`, `TrinityDetector`, `JsonArrayParser`, and `IQuestQ1JsonToolParser`, as well as `tool_choice="required"` fallback via `JsonArrayParser`).

### `cProfile` Breakdown Before Optimization (13.3 KB `write_file` tool call, 4,500 chunks on `Qwen25Detector`)
- `_find_common_prefix` (`utils.py:177`): **47.4% (3.53s)** — 4,492 calls scanning and concatenating `prefix += s1[i]` char-by-char in Python
- `_partial_json_loads` -> `partial_json_parser.core.myelin.fix_fast` / `complete_str`: **43.1% (3.20s)** — 4,499 full scans + `json.loads`
- `json.dumps`: **7.1% (0.53s)** — 8,985 full dict re-serializations

(Cross-pollinated from the corresponding streaming tool-parser optimizations in `vllm-project/vllm#61253`, `vllm-project/vllm#61494`, and `vllm-project/vllm#62334`.)

## Modifications

1. **`python/sglang/srt/function_call/utils.py` (`_find_common_prefix`)**:
   - Replace the $O(N)$ Python character-by-character loop + string concatenation (`prefix += s1[i]`) with C-level slice comparisons via binary search (`s1[low:mid] == s2[low:mid]`), with an $O(1)$ fast check when `s1[:min_length] == s2[:min_length]`.
2. **`python/sglang/srt/function_call/base_format_detector.py` (`BaseFormatDetector.parse_streaming_increment`)**:
   - Add an $O(|\text{delta}|)$ open-string streaming fast path when `BaseFormatDetector` is streaming inside an open top-level string argument of `arguments`/`parameters` (brace depth 2: outer tool-call object `{` and inner `arguments` object `{`).
   - Subsequent chunks that only append simple characters or 2-character escapes (`\"`, `\\`, `\b`, `\f`, `\n`, `\r`, `\t`) decode and emit the exact JSON string delta in $O(|\text{delta}|)$ without invoking `_partial_json_loads`, `_is_complete_json`, or `json.dumps` on the full buffer.
   - Preserve exact chunk-by-chunk parity with `partial_json_parser` and `BaseFormatDetector`:
     - Hold back trailing whitespace inside open strings (matching `partial_json_parser.core.complete._fix`, which calls `.strip()` before closing an incomplete string) and trailing odd backslashes until the next non-whitespace character arrives.
     - Hold back the last character via `_open_arg_pending_delta` on entry so each chunk emits the exact prefix shared between `prev_args_json` and `cur_args_json`.
     - Guard against retroactive single-quote buffer rewrites in `Llama32Detector` (`_open_arg_quote_pos`) and fall back seamlessly to the full parser whenever a closing quote `"`, complex escape (`\uXXXX`, `\/`, etc.), or structural transition arrives.
3. **`test/registered/unit/function_call/test_function_call_parser.py`**:
   - Add unit tests in `TestBaseFormatDetector` covering split escape sequences (`\"`, `\\`, `\n`, `\t`, `\b`, `\f`, `\r`, `\/`, `\uXXXX`), whitespace runs, multi-argument transitions, `_find_common_prefix` edge cases, and a regression check verifying `_partial_json_loads` is called $O(1)$ times (< 30 calls) across a >1,500-chunk string stream.

## Accuracy Tests

- Verified 100% chunk-by-chunk `StreamingParseResult`, `prev_tool_call_arr`, and `streamed_args_for_tool` equivalence across 2,000 randomized differential fuzzing trials (varying chunk sizes `1..25`, simple/unicode escapes, whitespace runs, quotes, braces, parallel tool calls, and truncated streams) across `Qwen25Detector`, `HermesDetector`, `Llama32Detector`, `MistralDetector`, `JsonArrayParser`, and `IQuestQ1JsonToolParser`.
- Ran existing + new unit test suites in `test/registered/unit/function_call/` (`TestBaseFormatDetector`, `TestQwen25Detector`, `TestHermesDetector`, `TestLlama32Detector`, `TestMistralDetector`, `TestJsonArrayParser`, `TestParallelToolCalls`).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

End-to-end streaming benchmark on a 13.3 KB `write_file` tool call streamed in 3-character chunks (~4,500 chunks) on ARM64 CPU:

| Detector | Before (ms) | After (ms) | Speedup |
| :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `Qwen25Detector` | 10,622.3 ms | **44.0 ms** | **241.5x** |
| `HermesDetector` | 10,469.1 ms | **47.5 ms** | **220.3x** |
| `JsonArrayParser` | 10,451.8 ms | **47.7 ms** | **219.2x** |
| `MistralDetector` | 10,478.8 ms | **60.1 ms** | **174.4x** |
| `Llama32Detector` | 10,614.0 ms | **126.6 ms** | **83.8x** |
| `Qwen25Detector` (20 KB `edit_file` with `old_str` + `new_str`) | 20,030.0 ms | **68.2 ms** | **293.6x** |

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

### Credits & Acknowledgments
- Inspired by the incremental tool-call argument streaming optimizations in vLLM by **@vMaroon** (`vllm-project/vllm#61253`), **@bbrowning** (`vllm-project/vllm#61494`), and **@deadstrobe5** (`vllm-project/vllm#62027`, `vllm-project/vllm#62035`), as well as **@divyvasal**'s streaming detector optimization in `sgl-project/sglang#44940`.

@@ -1,7 +1,8 @@
 import json
 import logging
+import re
 from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
-from typing import Any, Dict, List, Literal, Optional, Union
+from typing import Any, Dict, List, Literal, Optional, Tuple, Union
 
 import orjson
 from partial_json_parser.core.exceptions import MalformedJSON
@@ -28,6 +29,179 @@
 
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
 
+_SIMPLE_ESCAPE_MAP = {
+    '"': '"',
+    "\\": "\\",
+    "b": "\b",
+    "f": "\f",
+    "n": "\n",
+    "r": "\r",
+    "t": "\t",
+}
+_STRUCTURAL_TOKEN_RE = re.compile(r'["\[\]{}]')
+_HEX_DIGITS = frozenset("0123456789abcdefABCDEF")
+_SURROGATE_RE = re.compile(r"\\u[dD][89abABcdefCDEF]")
+
+
+def _is_escaped(text: str, index: int) -> bool:
+    bs = 0
+    k = index - 1
+    while k >= 0 and text[k] == "\\":
+        bs += 1
+        k -= 1
+    return (bs % 2) == 1
+
+
+def _check_open_top_level_arg_string(
+    raw_json: str, expected_key: Optional[str] = None
+) -> Optional[int]:
+    """Return the consumed prefix length if ``raw_json`` ends inside an open
+    top-level string value of ``arguments``/``parameters`` (brace depth 2),
+    or ``None`` if full partial-JSON parsing is required."""
+    in_string = False
+    prev_string_start = -1
+    last_string_start = -1
+    last_string_end = -1
+    top_stack: List[Tuple[int, str, int, int]] = []
+    for match in _STRUCTURAL_TOKEN_RE.finditer(raw_json):
+        i = match.start()
+        ch = match.group()
+        if ch == '"':
+            if not in_string:
+                in_string = True
+                last_string_start = i
+            elif not _is_escaped(raw_json, i):
+                in_string = False
+                prev_string_start = last_string_start
+                last_string_end = i
+        elif not in_string:
+            if ch in "{[":
+                top_stack.append((i, ch, prev_string_start, last_string_end))
+            else:
+                if not top_stack:
+                    return None
+                top_stack.pop()
+                if not top_stack:
+                    return None
+
+    if not in_string or len(top_stack) != 2:
+        return None
+    if top_stack[0][1] != "{" or top_stack[1][1] != "{":
+        return None
+    arg_obj_pos, _, arg_key_start, arg_key_end = top_stack[1]
+    if arg_key_start <= top_stack[0][0]:
+        return None
+    if raw_json[arg_key_end + 1 : arg_obj_pos].strip() != ":":
+        return None
+    if raw_json[arg_key_start + 1 : arg_key_end] not in ("arguments", "parameters"):
+        return None
+
+    if prev_string_start <= arg_obj_pos:
+        return None
+    if raw_json[last_string_end + 1 : last_string_start].strip() != ":":
+        return None
+    if (
+        expected_key is not None
+        and raw_json[prev_string_start + 1 : last_string_end] != expected_key
+    ):
+        return None
+
+    # partial_json_parser strips trailing whitespace before completing open strings.
+    stripped_end = len(raw_json.rstrip())
+    tail_window = raw_json[max(last_string_start + 1, stripped_end - 12) : stripped_end]
+    if (
+        "\\U" in tail_window
+        or "\\x" in tail_window
+        or _SURROGATE_RE.search(tail_window) is not None
+    ):
+        return None
+    _u = raw_json.rfind(
+        "\\u", max(last_string_start + 1, stripped_end - 5), stripped_end
+    )
+    if _u != -1 and not _is_escaped(raw_json, _u):
+        if stripped_end < len(raw_json):
+            return None
+        return _u
+    bs_count = stripped_end - len(raw_json[:stripped_end].rstrip("\\"))
+    if bs_count % 2 == 1:
+        if stripped_end < len(raw_json):
+            return None
+        return stripped_end - 1
+    return stripped_end
+
+
+def _decode_simple_json_str_delta(
+    raw_tail: str, reject_single_quote: bool = False
+) -> Optional[Tuple[int, str, str]]:
+    """Incrementally decode a chunk suffix inside an open JSON string value.
+
+    Returns ``(consumed_len, encoded_delta, decoded_delta)`` when ``raw_tail``
+    only contains characters and simple escapes whose ``json.dumps``
+    representation can be computed directly, or ``None`` if ``raw_tail``
+    closes the string or contains escapes requiring the full parser."""
+    if not raw_tail:
+        return 0, "", ""
+    stripped_len = len(raw_tail.rstrip())
+    n = len(raw_tail)
+    i = 0
+    encoded_chars: List[str] = []
+    decoded_chars: List[str] = []
+    while i < n:
+        ch = raw_tail[i]
+        if ch == '"':
+            return None
+        if ch == "\\":
+            if i + 1 >= n:
+                if i < stripped_len:
+                    break
+                return None
+            nxt = raw_tail[i + 1]
+            if nxt in _SIMPLE_ESCAPE_MAP:
+                if nxt == "/":
+                    return None
+                if i < stripped_len:
+                    encoded_chars.append(raw_tail[i : i + 2])
+                    decoded_chars.append(_SIMPLE_ESCAPE_MAP[nxt])
+                i += 2
+                continue
+            if nxt == "u":
+                if i + 6 > n:
+                    if stripped_len == n and all(
+                        c in _HEX_DIGITS for c in raw_tail[i + 2 : n]
+                    ):
+                        break
+                    return None
+                hex4 = raw_tail[i + 2 : i + 6]
+                if not all(c in _HEX_DIGITS for c in hex4):
+                    return None
+                code = int(hex4, 16)
+                if code < 0x20 or (0xD800 <= code <= 0xDFFF):
+                    return None
+                dec = chr(code)
+                if (
+                    dec == '"'
+                    or dec == "\\"
+                    or (reject_single_quote and dec == "'")
+                ):
+                    return None
+                if i < stripped_len:
+                    encoded_chars.append(dec)
+                    decoded_chars.append(dec)
+                i += 6
+                continue
+            return None
+        if (
+            ord(ch) < 0x20
+            or (reject_single_quote and ch == "'")
+            or (0xD800 <= ord(ch) <= 0xDFFF)
+        ):
+            return None
+        if i < stripped_len:
+            encoded_chars.append(ch)
+            decoded_chars.append(ch)
+        i += 1
+    return min(i, stripped_len), "".join(encoded_chars), "".join(decoded_chars)
+
 
 class BaseFormatDetector(ABC):
     """Base class providing two sets of interfaces: one-time and streaming incremental."""
@@ -51,6 +225,12 @@ def __init__(self):
         # Each index corresponds to a tool_id. Example: ['{"location": "San Francisco"', '{"temp": 72']
         self.streamed_args_for_tool: List[str] = []
 
+        # Open-string streaming fast-path state (O(1) per chunk inside string arguments)
+        self._open_arg_key: Optional[str] = None
+        self._open_arg_consumed_pos: int = 0
+        self._open_arg_quote_pos: int = -1
+        self._open_arg_pending_delta: str = ""
+
         # Token configuration (override in subclasses)
         self.bot_token = ""
         self.eot_token = ""
@@ -144,6 +324,52 @@ def parse_streaming_increment(
         self._buffer += new_text
         current_text = self._buffer
 
+        # Fast path: when streaming inside an open top-level string argument,
+        # extend the open string in O(|delta|) without re-running partial_json_parser
+        # and json.dumps over the entire accumulated buffer on every chunk.
+        open_key = getattr(self, "_open_arg_key", None)
+        if (
+            open_key is not None
+            and self.current_tool_name_sent
+            and 0 <= self.current_tool_id < len(self.prev_tool_call_arr)
+        ):
+            try:
+                consumed_pos = self._open_arg_consumed_pos
+                quote_pos = self._open_arg_quote_pos
+                reject_sq = self.bot_token == "<|python_tag|>"
+                if len(current_text) >= consumed_pos and (
+                    not reject_sq or quote_pos == -1 or current_text[quote_pos] == "'"
+                ):
+                    raw_tail = current_text[consumed_pos:]
+                    decoded_info = _decode_simple_json_str_delta(
+                        raw_tail, reject_single_quote=reject_sq
+                    )
+                    if decoded_info is not None:
+                        consumed_len, encoded_delta, decoded_delta = decoded_info
+                        if consumed_len == 0:
+                            return StreamingParseResult()
+                        self._open_arg_consumed_pos = consumed_pos + consumed_len
+                        prev_args = self.prev_tool_call_arr[self.current_tool_id][
+                            "arguments"
+                        ]
+                        prev_args[open_key] = prev_args[open_key] + decoded_delta
+                        argument_diff = self._open_arg_pending_delta
